profiles.name: Ronald Kiandee
profiles.description: Ronald Kiandee represents Beluran, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Parliament records affiliation with Perikatan Nasional (PN).
profiles.affiliation_note: Parliament’s PN label is retained. The March report records his suspension from Bersatu and removal from party posts. Earlier vice-president status or association with Wawasan leaders is not proof of a current party office or new membership.

profiles.name: Khairul Firdaus Akbar Khan
profiles.description: Khairul Firdaus Akbar Khan represents Batu Sapi, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Deputy Minister of Human Resources. Parliament records affiliation with Gabungan Rakyat Sabah (GRS).
profiles.affiliation_note: Parliament’s current GRS coalition label is retained. Service addresses, event attendance and earlier Bersatu membership are not used to assign a current component party. No court judgment is converted into a delivery milestone.

milestones.title: Launch National Training Week 2026 in Sandakan
milestones.description: The HRD Corp statement reports Khairul Firdaus officiating the 18 July launch, ahead of free learning activities beginning on 20 July.
milestones.progress_note: Published 19 July about the previous evening’s launch. Achieved covers the launch only, not course completion, participant employment or delivery of every roadshow stop. HRD Corp and KESUMA organised the programme.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
